title: Preparing for Eternity Not Just This Life
description: In this powerful message, Pastor Chris Zehner reveals the reward system that God has set in place for believers in heaven, where every thought, word, and deed will be weighed and rewarded. With a deep understanding of Scripture, Pastor Chris unpacks the importance of living a life of honor and excellence, preparing us for the judgment seat of Christ, where our eternal rewards will be determined. Join Pastor Chris as he sets the stage for a series of messages that will challenge and encourage you to live a life that honors God and prepares you for the next life.
